en.content:
Create four character sheets in advance — three female characters and one car — and have Seedance 2.5 reference all four at once to generate a one-minute video that maintains consistency across multiple characters.

Deliberately include long-form content, multiple characters, and frequent switches between scenes/time of day (sea → drive → hotel → city → night, etc.) to stress-test how well the system can preserve the people and the car.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] 1/

Here’s what I referenced this time:

・3 female characters  
・1 car

I created a character sheet for each in advance,
then had Seedance 2.5 reference all four simultaneously to generate a one-minute video.

Character sheets here👇 https://t.co/oZrt1X3wNG

[Thread 2] 2/

From the sea, to driving, to the hotel, the city, and night scenes,
I generated a summer travel vlog with the same three characters.

I’m testing how well consistency can be maintained under conditions that are prone to breaking it:
long-form + multiple characters + frequent scene changes.

[Thread 3] 3/

This time I used Seedance 2.5 on Pollo AI.
